================================================================================
Oracle blocks: a procedure with declarations after IS
================================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE p (a IN NUMBER) IS
  v NUMBER := 0;
  CURSOR c IS SELECT id FROM t;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN c LOOP
    IF r.id > a THEN
      v := v + 1;
    ELSIF r.id = a THEN
      NULL;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  DECLARE
    w NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    w := CASE WHEN v > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
  END;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RAISE;
END p;
SELECT 1 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle blocks: a function with AS and a CASE statement
================================================================================

create function f (x number) return varchar2 as
begin
  case x
    when 1 then return 'one';
    else return 'END';
  end case;
end;
select f(1) from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (string)
    (string))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle blocks: a trigger with a DECLARE section
================================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE EDITIONABLE TRIGGER tr
BEFORE INSERT ON t REFERENCING NEW AS n FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
  k NUMBER;
BEGIN
  SELECT s.nextval INTO k FROM dual;
  :n.id := k;
END;
SELECT 2 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle blocks: a call specification ends at its semicolon
================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE j (a VARCHAR2) AS LANGUAGE JAVA NAME 'J.run(java.lang.String)';
CREATE FUNCTION e RETURN NUMBER AS EXTERNAL LIBRARY l NAME "e";
SELECT 3 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (string))
  (statement
    (quoted_identifier))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle blocks: a row trigger with :new right after BEGIN
================================================================================

create trigger t before update on d for each row begin :new.x := 1; end;
select 1 from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    (variable

================================================================================
Oracle blocks: each form of a variable right after BEGIN
================================================================================

create trigger t1 before insert on d for each row begin :x := 1; end;
create trigger t2 before insert on d for each row begin :'name' := 1; end;
create trigger t3 before insert on d for each row begin :"name" := 1; end;
create trigger t4 before insert on d for each row begin :{?name} := 1; end;
select 1 from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle blocks: a variable in a nested block and before the last END
================================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER t
BEFORE UPDATE ON d FOR EACH ROW
DECLARE
  k NUMBER;
BEGIN
  IF :new.a > 0 THEN
    BEGIN
      :new.b := :old.b;
    END;
  END IF;
  :new.c := :"v";
END;
SELECT 1 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name))
    (variable
      (variable_name))
    (variable
      (variable_name))
    (variable
      (variable_name))
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle blocks: a label or a parenthesis right after BEGIN
================================================================================

create trigger t before update on d for each row begin <<l>> null; end;
create procedure p is begin (select 1 from dual); end;
create procedure q is begin <<outer>> begin <<inner>> null; end; end;
select 1 from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle blocks: a string, a quoted identifier or a sign right after BEGIN
================================================================================

create procedure p is begin 'x'; end;
create procedure q is begin "x" := 1; end;
create procedure r is begin -1; end;
create procedure s is begin /* a */ -- b
  <<l>> begin 'y'; end; end;
select 1 from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (string))
  (statement
    (quoted_identifier))
  (statement)
  (statement
    (comment)
    (comment)
    (string))
  (statement))
